description: This Java class 'PcChargeServices' provides payment processing services such as authorization, capture, release, and refund through the PCCharge API, including handling credit card info and configuration properties.

classes.name: PcChargeServices
classes.description: A utility class providing payment transaction methods for credit card authorization, capture, release, and refund via PCCharge API.

methods.name: ccAuth
methods.description: Performs credit card authorization, returning transaction result details.

methods.name: setCreditCardInfo
methods.description: Sets credit card details into the API from context data.

methods.name: getApi
methods.description: Creates and configures a PcChargeApi instance based on properties.

methods.name: buildPccProperties
methods.description: Builds configuration properties for PCCharge API from project settings.

methods.name: getAmountString
methods.description: Formats amount from context with proper scale and rounding.
